pricing.question: How Does Pricing Work?
pricing.everyday: Everyday clothing and linens (such as shirts, pants, underwear, socks, towels, and bedsheets) are priced by the pound. This covers washing, drying, and neatly folding your items together.
pricing.special: Some bulky or special-care items require their own dedicated wash or dry cycle due to size, material, or hygiene reasons. These items are priced per item, not by weight.
pricing.finalNote: Final pricing is calculated after your laundry is processed, based on actual weight and item type.

preparation.question: How Do I Prepare My Order for Pickup?
preparation.answer: Bag all your laundry in a disposable bag or a reusable bag (which we'll return along with your cleaned clothes). Tie it shut to keep everything secure, and leave it outside your door before your pickup window begins — we'll handle the rest!

sorting.question: Do I Need to Separate Whites & Darks?
sorting.answer: Nope! Just toss everything together — when your laundry arrives at our facility, we'll sort it for you so your whites stay bright and your darks stay vibrant. You don't have to worry about a thing!

cancelAnytime.question: Can I cancel my subscription anytime?
cancelAnytime.answer: Yes! You can cancel your subscription at any time. Your benefits will continue until the end of your current billing period.

exceedLimit.question: What happens if I exceed my monthly weight limit?
exceedLimit.answer: Additional weight beyond your plan limit is charged at our regular rate of $2.45/lb. You'll be notified before any extra charges.

studentVerification.question: Do student plans require verification?
studentVerification.answer: Yes, we'll need to see a valid student ID at your first pickup. The ID must show current enrollment status.

pauseSubscription.question: Can I pause my subscription?
pauseSubscription.answer: Yes, you can pause your subscription for up to 2 months per year at no cost. Just contact us 3 days before your next billing date.

earnings.question: How much can I expect to earn?
earnings.answer: Drivers typically earn Up  to $35 per completed route. With 10-15 routes per week, most drivers make $300-500 weekly. Pay depends on your effort and availability.

experience.question: Do I need delivery experience?
experience.answer: No experience required! We provide full training on our system, customer service, and efficient route planning.

areas.question: What areas do you serve?
areas.answer: Currently serving the Greater Toronto Area including Toronto, North York, Scarborough, Etobicoke, Mississauga, Brampton, and Vaughan.

payment.question: When do I get paid?
payment.answer: Payments are processed weekly for all completed deliveries. Direct deposit to your bank account every Friday.

responsibilities.question: What are my responsibilities?
responsibilities.answer: Pick up laundry from customers, transport to our facility, then deliver clean clothes back. Minimal customer interaction required.
